senses.gloss: (כִּיֵּיד) כִּיֵּיר (denom. of כִּירָה II or of כַּד II) [to do the work of the stove-setter or of the potter (כַּיָּיר or כַּיָּיד, v. בִּרְכַּיָּיר),] to cement; to lay out with tiles, panels &c. [Ar. reads ר, editions mostly ד.] B. Kam. 51ᵃ bot. אחד … וסייד וכ׳ (Ms. F. וסייר וכייר) if one dug a pit ten handbreadths deep, and another came and lined it with plaster and cemented it; Mekh. Mishp., N’zik., s. 11.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 3:7">Ab. Zar. III, 7</cite> (<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 47b">47ᵇ</cite>) <he>סיידו וכִיְּירוֹ לאליל</he> Mish. (Bab. ed. <he>וכיידו לע״ז</he>) he plastered the room and put tiles on (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Abacus) designing it for idolatrous purposes.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 47b">Ib.</cite> <he>סיידה וכִיְּירָהּ וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>וציירה</he>) if one plastered and stuccoed a stone (slab) for an idolatrous purpose.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 28">Gen. R. s. 28</cite> <he>סיידה וכיירה וציירה</he> he plastered and panelled and painted the wedding chamber; <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 2:8">Lam. R. to IV, 11</cite> <he>וכיידה</he>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 8:7">Tosef. Sot. VIII, 7</cite> <he>כִּיְּירוּהוּ וסיידוהו וכ׳</he> (Var. <he>כִּיְּדוּהָ</he>, <he>כִּיְּרוּהָ</he>) they panelled the stone and stuccoed it and wrote upon it.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 60b:8">B. Bath. 60ᵇ</cite> <he>אין מסיידין ואין מְכַיְּירִין וכ׳</he> we must not decorate our rooms with plaster, panels and paintings in these days (after the destruction of the Temple); <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Batra 2:17">Tosef. ib. II, 17</cite>.—Part. pass. <he>מְכוּיָּיר</he>, f. <he>מְכוּיֶּירֶת</he>.
